items.title: fix(irc): reject sanitized-empty sends before reply metadata (#129660)
items.summary: fix(irc): reject sanitized-empty sends before reply metadata (#129660) Validate message content at the IRC transport owner, then encode its separate reply reference. Preserve original wire rendering and route empty-content failures through existing send and automatic-reply error paths without false receipts or activity. Four baseline regressions fail on the original code; the original one-line proposal still fails the threaded case. The full repair passes all 184 IRC tests, full selected checks, and independent P0-P2 review. Refs #129660.
